channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: Polestar Drove Its 870 HP Flagship From Gothenburg to the Sahara to Settle the Range Question
item.dc:creator: Polestar
item.description: Polestar turned the launch of its 5 flagship into a 6,500 km drive from Sweden to Morocco, making range the headline rather than the car. Published specs put it near 650 kW and 870 hp on a 103 kWh battery.

item.title: TELO Hands the Bones of Its Tiny Electric Truck to an Aerospace Metal Supplier
item.dc:creator: TELO Trucks
item.description: TELO says it has signed Schwab Industries, a Michigan metal firm, to build the body-in-white for its compact electric pickup, after locking down its internal crash safety targets.

item.title: Solar Is Now the Cheapest Power in History, and an Oil Scare Is Speeding It Up
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: Global Solar Council CEO Sonia Dunlop tells Everything Electric that solar plus storage now leads new generation worldwide, with Pakistan's rooftop boom the standout case.

item.title: The Renault 4 With a Roll-Back Roof Costs £1,500 More and Loses Just Four Miles
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying drives the canvas-roof Renault 4. The fabric roof adds about 19 kg and trims range by only four miles, with bidirectional charging standard and a post-grant price near £27,500.

item.title: An Ex-SpaceX Engineer Is Trying to Replace the Wood in American Homes With Grass
item.dc:creator: The Hustle
item.description: The Hustle visits Plantd, a North Carolina startup making a grass-based OSB alternative in small electric mills, with a 10 million panel order from the largest US homebuilder.

item.title: China Now Sells One in Three Cars on Earth, and the US Watches From Behind a Tariff Wall
item.dc:creator: Two Bit da Vinci
item.description: Two Bit da Vinci lays out the scale: 34.4 million vehicles sold in China in 2025, 35.6% of the global market, EVs under $10,000, and a US tariff wall that keeps all of it out.

item.title: Texas Instruments Built a Chip That Lets a BMS See Inside the Cell
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: At a German power show, TI demos EIS chips that read cell impedance in real time, promising earlier thermal runaway alerts, faster charging, and far better LFP state of charge.

item.title: Riding Shotgun as XPeng's P7 Drives Itself Through Chinese Traffic the US Bans
item.dc:creator: CNET
item.description: A reporter tests XPeng's VLA 2.0 self-driving in China, threading pedestrians and tight squeezes with two human takeovers, plus a look at the company's flying machines.

item.title: Towing Lightship's Self-Propelled Trailer Behind a Rivian Nearly Erases the Range Penalty
item.dc:creator: Miss GoElectric
item.description: The production AE.1 uses its own 80 kW motor and hitch-force sensors to cancel trailer drag, holding a Rivian within about 5% of its unladen range at 8,000 pounds.

item.title: The Arctic Leopard XE Pro R Puts Full-Size Wheels on a 175-Pound eMoto for $5,799
item.dc:creator: Electric Cycle Rider
item.description: Electric Cycle Rider's first ride finds 26.5 kW, big 21 and 18 inch wheels, Surron-style brakes, and plush KKE suspension on a light, flickable trail bike at $5,799.

item.title: RJ Scaringe on Why Rivian Bet Everything on Owning Its Own Software
item.dc:creator: Masters of Scale
item.description: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe explains the early call to build its own electronics and software, the $5.8 billion Volkswagen licensing deal, the R2 ramp, the Uber robotaxi plan and a self-driving roadmap that goes unsupervised next year.

item.title: A Used Hyundai IONIQ 6 for $21,000 Is Quietly One of the Best EV Deals Going
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec helps Lacey buy a used IONIQ 6 SE with 24,000 miles for around $21,000, about $25,000 all-in. It is an 800-volt EV that still pulled past 200 kW on a DC charger. The catch is the ICCU.

item.title: GM and Peak Energy Built a Grid Battery That Cools Itself With No Fans or Coolant
item.dc:creator: Munro Live
item.description: GM is making sodium-ion cells in Warren, Michigan for a Peak Energy storage system that needs no liquid cooling. Modules stack on a tilt so heat rises and pulls air through on its own. Cheaper materials, decades of cycle life.

item.title: CATL Is Talking About a Battery With Almost the Energy Density of Gasoline
item.dc:creator: Ben Alexxander
item.description: CATL named lithium-air as a long-term research goal. Its theoretical energy density sits near gasoline at about 12,000 Wh/kg, and lab cells have reportedly topped 1,200 Wh/kg, several times today's packs. Likely a 2035-plus technology.

item.title: This Route 66 Fast Charger Runs on Sunlight With No Grid Connection at All
item.dc:creator: Scott Explains
item.description: Coral Charge built an off-grid solar fast-charging station in Barstow, California. Roughly 600 panels, battery storage in each unit and up to 180 kW out, with no utility hookup. Pricing runs 50 cents per kWh.

item.title: The Leapmotor B05 Is a Sub-€33,000 Electric Hatch Aimed at the Golf and Astra
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Autogefühl drives the Leapmotor B05, a compact electric hatchback priced from about €32,000 with a 67 kWh LFP battery, roughly 250 miles of real-world range and a 10 to 80 percent charge in around 18 minutes. It is sold through the same Stellantis dealers as the Opel Astra, and the cabin quality is the real surprise.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
